description: Replies to a message (to the sender, or everyone with replyAll). The original is quoted below the reply and threading headers are set. To reply in a thread, use the id of its latest message from get_thread. body or htmlBody is required. Confirm with the user before sending.

attachments.description: Attachments. Combined size must not exceed 25MB.

filename.description: File name shown to recipients, e.g. "invoice.pdf".

inline.description: If true, an inline image referenced from htmlBody as where N is its zero-based index in attachments.

mimeType.description: IANA MIME type. Defaults to application/octet-stream.

bcc.description: Bcc recipients. Plain email addresses (e.g. "user@example.com"); "Name <user@example.com>" also works.

body.description: Plain text body. Do NOT format with Markdown; use htmlBody for rich text. If htmlBody is also given, this is the plain-text alternative.

cc.description: Overrides the default Cc recipients. Plain email addresses (e.g. "user@example.com"); "Name <user@example.com>" also works.

replyAll.description: Reply to all recipients. Default false.

to.description: Overrides the default reply recipients. Plain email addresses (e.g. "user@example.com"); "Name <user@example.com>" also works.

name: reply
